pr_title: workspace: Add settings to dim inactive panes and highlight active pane
pr_body:
Closes #12529
Closes #8639

Release Notes:

- Added option to dim inactive panes ([#12529](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12529))
- Added option to highlight active pane with a border ([#8639](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8639))

BREAKING: `active_pane_magnification` value is no longer used, it should be migrated to `active_pane_modifiers.magnification`

![panes](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b19959bc-4c06-4320-be36-412113143af5)

> note: don't know much rust, so I wouldn't be surprised if stuff can be done much better, happy to update things after the review.
Also, wasn't sure about introducing the new object in the settings, but it felt better than adding two more keys to the root, let me know what you think and if there's a better way to do this. Also happy to get feedback on the text itself, as I didn't spend much thinking how to document this.

issue_context.title: dim inactive panes
issue_context.body: ### Check for existing issues - [X] Completed ### Describe the feature I usually work with multiple code splits, and without tabs, and I find it sometimes hard to know on what split I'm focused, as the cursor is small and it's in some random place of the codebase similar to how zed has a setting for magnifying the active pane, I'd like to have a setting for dimming inactive panes, with a float number between 0 and 1, where 0 is completely transparent, and 1 is fully opaque I checked the codebase a bit to see how this could be implemented but I didn't see any obvious way of achieving this, but I'd be very happy to contribute this feature if someone can provide me with some pointers ### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help present your vision of the feature
